ecna-1991.notes: Source 1 (dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/152751.152762) is the record page of an article on the 1992 ACM Scholastic Programming Contest Finals (World Finals); it belongs with the 1992 World Finals, not ecna-1991, unless the article body (not in our copy, which has only the record page) also covers the regional.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a different copy (the ACM Digital Library homepage) and called it not the document; our copy is the article's own record page, a real document but about the 1992 Finals rather than this regional.
sources.evidence: The page is the ACM Digital Library record of the SIGCSE Bulletin article 'Results and problems from the 1992 ACM Scholastic Programming Contest Finals' (Vol. 25 No. 2, June 1993), with metadata and a first-page image only; nothing on it names the East Central regional.

ecna-1992.notes: Source 2: roles corrected from rankings to report + standings (partial, top 10): the list gives total time and problems solved, not only the order. Source 1 (usenetarchives.com) copy is a script-filled shell with no posts; it may be the same thread, but our copy shows nothing of it.

sources.evidence: The page is the Usenet Archives thread view with an empty 'Posts:' area filled by script; only the site's menus, a report-abuse form and its about text are in our copy, with no message of the thread.
A post of 25 Nov 1992 in the thread lists the top ten East Central finishers with total time and number of problems solved, inside a newsgroup discussion of regional results.

ecna-1993.notes: usenetarchives.com thread pages load their posts by script; our copy has none of the thread. A new capture (rendered) or the same thread on Google Groups is needed.

sources.evidence: The page is the Usenet Archives thread view with an empty 'Posts:' area filled by script; only the site's menus, a report-abuse form and its about text are in our copy, with no message and no results.

ecna-1995.notes: Source 2 (usenetarchives.com thread view) is an empty script-driven shell in our copy: no post text was captured; the scoreboard posting would need a different capture (e.g. a rendered page or the raw message).

sources.evidence: The page is the Usenet Archives thread-view shell for comp.org.acm with only site boilerplate (about text, abuse form); the posts are loaded by script and no message text, contest name or results appear anywhere in our copy.

ecna-1997.notes: Source 1 (uwaterloo.ca past-successes) is Waterloo's list of its World Finals placings (top-20 finishes), not a document of ECNA 1997; it might serve as a second-hand rankings source for the World Finals editions instead.

sources.evidence: The University of Waterloo 'Past Successes' page lists the university's ICPC World Finals placings 1993-2023 (1997: rank 5) and says nothing about the East Central North America regional.
